basis.population: STANDARD PaperTrade rows, isDemo=0, opened at/after the L2 corpus epoch
basis.decisionPrice: PaperTrade.entryPrice (the quote STANDARD read at scoring time and booked)
basis.deltaCents: attainable - decisionPrice, in cents; POSITIVE = worse than booked
basis.attainment: lowest best-ask (book) / lowest print (tape) inside the lag window — REACHABILITY, not a fill
basis.refutation: fires only when n >= 300 legs carry a mid AND |mean (attainable - mid)| <= 0.3c

book.reason: NOT EVALUABLE: n=251 of the required 300 legs carry a stamp with a mid (book arm), so the ±0.3c test has no population to fire on. Nothing is refuted and nothing is confirmed.

tape.reason: NOT EVALUABLE: n=0 of the required 300 legs carry a stamp with a mid (tape arm), so the ±0.3c test has no population to fire on. Nothing is refuted and nothing is confirmed.
